headline: Approved prior meeting minutes; heard updates on clubhouse construction, pro shop revenue, and course work.
summary: Milestone Construction gave an update on the clubhouse project, with the move to the new clubhouse expected in mid-November. Driving range and pro shop revenue are down because of the construction, and staff expects a rebound next year. Members approved the prior minutes, and there was no public input.
decisions: Approved the minutes from the July 9, 2026 meeting by unanimous voice vote.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion was made and seconded to approve the minutes from the July 9, 2026 meeting. The minutes were approved with a unanimous voice vote.

plain_text:
MINUTES
Beaver Meadow Golf Advisory Committee Meeting
September 17, 2026
In Attendance: Chris Mulleavey, Jennifer Kretovic, Nathan Fennessy, Steve Norton, Bob 
Whatmough, Judith Fairclough, Roger Jobin, Mack Bean, Charlie Randall, Craig Savage, Jim 
Tanner, Jerise Mares, Tom Aspell, Pat Lanman, and Josh Lacasse.
Excused: Gary Darby.
1) Approval of Meeting Minutes: A motion was made and seconded to approve the minutes 
from the July 9, 2026 meeting. The minutes were approved with a unanimous voice vote.
2) Clubhouse Project Update: Brian Gehris and Geoff Lemay of Milestone Construction 
provided an update on the clubhouse project.
 The project is moving along well, with interior work such as painting, drywall, and 
ceilings being done now.
 Base paving of the parking lot is done.
 The transition to the new clubhouse is expected to occur in mid-November, at which time
demolition of the old clubhouse will begin and occur throughout the winter.
 Finish paving will be done in the spring.
3) Pro Shop Update:
 Pat Lanman provided a year over year comparison of rounds and revenue, as well as 
season passes.
 Driving range revenue is down, and was expected, due to the construction project. Pro 
Shop revenue is also down due to less demo days being held.
 Staff fully expects driving range and pro shop revenue to bounce back next year, after the
construction project is done and golf course operations are back to normal.
 A simulator league will be held in the new clubhouse this winter.
4) Course Update:
 Greens and tees have been aerated. Fairways will be done next.
 There are no big fall projects planned. Staff will continue to make improvements to the 
cart paths and greens, and prepare for winter.
5) New Business:
 Jennifer Kretovic suggested that staff look at the potential of adding a Senior 7-Day 
membership category.
 Jennifer also expressed her concern that the Beaver Meadow Brook culvert is failing due 
to the poor condition of Sewalls Falls Road. This brook directly feeds water to the golf 
course.
6) 5 Minutes of Public Input: There was no public input.
7) Adjournment: A motion was made and seconded, and the meeting was adjourned at 8:56
AM with a unanimous voice vote.
